description: Cancels the signed-in member's booking (or waitlist spot) for a class. The gym's cancellation deadline applies; a late cancel may count as used. The answer includes the gym's address and maps link. Each gym includes, when Gymmy has it: full address, city, country, coordinates (geo), mapsUrl (Google Maps), directionsUrl, appleMapsUrl, logoUrl (the salle logo or a sourced photo, null when there is none), listingUrl (public page, null when the gym is not public), phone, public email, website and opening hours, and null for anything Gymmy does not have. gym, classId and memberId are internal ids, used as arguments of other Gymmy tools.

gym.description: Gym id from my_schedule or get_my_account. Optional: found from the class when the person belongs to several gyms.

locale.description: Answer language: fr (default), en, pt, es or de. Pass en when the person writes in English.

name: cancel_booking

gym.description: A gym. `gym` is its internal id, used as an argument of other Gymmy tools.

address.description: Full postal address (street, postcode, city, country). Null when unknown.

appleMapsUrl.description: Apple Maps URL for the same place.

country.description: Country, ISO alpha-2 when the gym stored one (FR, PT…).

directionsUrl.description: Google Maps directions URL to the gym.

email.description: Public contact email of the gym. Not a member email.

listingUrl.description: Public listing or published gym page. Null when the gym is not public.

logoUrl.description: Salle logo or sourced photo. Null when the gym has none. Never invent one.

mapsUrl.description: Google Maps search URL built from coordinates, or from the address.

openingHours.description: Opening hours in one line, when known.

phone.description: Public phone. Null when the gym has not published one.

styles.description: Yoga or pilates style ids (bikram, vinyasa, hatha, yin, reformer, lagree, …). The discipline stays in activities.

title: Cancel a booking
